findings.title: start() can restore RUNNING after the monitor has exited
findings.body: start() sleeps 0.5 seconds and then sets RUNNING when poll() is None. A monitor failure in that window sets ERROR and exits, and start() can overwrite ERROR. is_running() is then true with no monitor until the terminated child is reaped, or indefinitely if the child ignores the terminate signal.
